paragraphes.source_en: She generally gave herself very good advice, (though she very seldom followed it), and sometimes she scolded herself so severely as to bring tears into her eyes; and once she remembered trying to box her own ears for having cheated herself in a game of croquet she was playing against herself, for this curious child was very fond of pretending to be two people.
paragraphes.cible: Elle avait pour habitude de se donner de très-bons conseils (bien qu'elle les suivît rarement), et quelquefois elle se grondait si fort que les larmes lui en venaient aux yeux.

paragraphes.source_en: Soon her eye fell on a little glass box that was lying under the table: she opened it, and found in it a very small cake, on which the words "EAT ME" were beautifully marked in currants.
paragraphes.cible: Elle aperçut alors une petite boîte en verre qui était sous la table, l'ouvrit et y trouva un tout petit gâteau sur lequel les mots "MANGEZ-MOI" étaient admirablement tracés avec des raisins de Corinthe.

paragraphes.source_en: She ate a little bit, and said anxiously to herself, "Which way? Which way?", holding her hand on the top of her head to feel which way it was growing, and she was quite surprised to find that she remained the same size.
paragraphes.cible: Elle mangea donc un petit morceau du gâteau, et, portant sa main sur sa tête, elle se dit tout inquiète: "Lequel est-ce? Lequel est-ce?"

paragraphes.source_en: Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it.
paragraphes.cible: ALICE, assise auprès de sa sœur sur le gazon, commençait à s'ennuyer de rester là à ne rien faire.

paragraphes.source_en: Suddenly she came upon a little three-legged table, all made of solid glass; there was nothing on it except a tiny golden key.
paragraphes.cible: Tout à coup elle rencontra sur son passage une petite table à trois pieds, en verre massif, et rien dessus qu'une toute petite clef d'or.

paragraphes.source_en: There seemed to be no use in waiting by the little door, so she went back to the table, half hoping she might find another key on it.
paragraphes.cible: Comme cela n'avançait à rien de passer son temps à attendre à la petite porte, elle retourna vers la table, espérant presque y trouver une autre clef.

paragraphes.source_en: It was all very well to say "Drink me," but the wise little Alice was not going to do that in a hurry.
paragraphes.cible: C'est bien facile à dire « Buvez-moi », mais Alice était trop fine pour obéir à l'aveuglette.

paragraphes.source_en: "What a curious feeling!" said Alice; "I must be shutting up like a telescope."
paragraphes.cible: « Je me sens toute drôle, » dit Alice, « on dirait que je rentre en moi-même et que je me ferme comme un télescope. »

paragraphes.source_en: After a while, finding that nothing more happened, she decided on going into the garden at once; but, alas for poor Alice! when she got to the door, she found she had forgotten the little golden key.
paragraphes.cible: Un moment après, voyant qu'il ne se passait plus rien, elle se décida à aller de suite au jardin ; mais hélas, pauvre Alice ! en arrivant à la porte, elle s'aperçut qu'elle avait oublié la petite clef d'or.
